messages:
sofia: Heads-up — Spectra submitted a Dedicated tuning request for their chat fleet this morning. Goal: sustain p95 <= 120ms at 1k RPS, avg 1.5k tokens/req. They want per-customer token-budget enforcement and stricter queue caps to avoid HOL blocking.

kenji: Can you paste the baseline perf snapshot and KV stats? want to check kernel selection and batch distribution.

sofia: From their support ticket: "latency spikes under burst, KV cache hit ~78%, high share of bsz=1 during peaks." Logs attached to the portal.

perf-bot: Perf snapshot: https://perf.internal/snapshots/spectra/1769001001 — baseline p95=190ms, avg_batch_size=3.1, continuous_batch_window=15ms, kernel=attn_fallback_v1.

maria: Two immediate levers: 1) prefer fused attention kernel (attn_v2/fused_attention_v2) — ~18% per-token cut in our bench for this architecture; 2) increase token_budget_per_batch and nudge continuous batch window up so batches form larger avg size, but pair that with hard queue_capacity to bound worst-case latency.

kenji: KV hit at 78% suggests prefix pinning could help. If we pin hot prefixes (weight > 0.6) our sim jumps hit -> ~88%. Also consider tightening idle-eviction for session-level KV entries for this customer.

sofia: Spectra's asks (from ops): per-customer token_budget throttle, queue_limit=300, allow small burst 1.2x, and explicit fallback to a smaller quantized model when queue > 80%.

josh: Drafting Dedicated batching config for canary. Pasting proposed JSON for review: ```json
{
  "customer": "spectra",
  "pool": "dedicated-us-west-2-spectra-1",
  "max_batch_tokens": "4096",
  "max_batch_items": "128",
  "continuous_batch_window_ms": "30",
  "queue_capacity": "300",
  "token_budget_per_minute": "3000000",
  "burst_multiplier": "1.2",
  "kv_cache_pin_threshold": "0.6",
  "prefer_kernel": "fused_attention_v2",
  "fallback_model": "gpt-small-q4_0",
  "fallback_trigger_pct": "80"
}
```

maria: Looks reasonable. If we enable the fused kernel we can tighten the window to 25ms (instead of 30ms) and still hit batch growth to ~5 tokens avg in sim. That keeps tail tighter.

kenji: Add priority classes for token_budget routing so production traffic isn't throttled by background jobs. Eg: `priority_classes: [prod, bg_eval]` with weights `[1.0, 0.3]`. Also add `token_budget_priority` to config.

sofia: Spectra said they'd tolerate a small QA regression if p95 improves. We should add a staged canary: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with rollback triggers: p95 > 130ms OR error_rate > 0.5%.

josh: Scheduling canary tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll push config to infra with a kernel override flag so we can revert kernel mapping independently. Also adding a `canary_checks` block to config.

eng-oncall: Noted. I'll wire up dashboards: per-route p50/p95, token_budget burn-rate, queue depth heatmap, and KV hit-rate alarm (alert if hit drops >5% from baseline). Adding an automated rollback hook to deployment pipeline. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Quick sim run with josh's config + maria tweak (window=25ms): avg_batch_size=5.2, p95 ~= 115ms, KV_hit=88%, estimated token cost -12%.

sofia: Great. Add the kernel selection change to the deploy notes and call out rollback instructions for SRE in case fused kernel causes regressions.

josh: Will do. Tests I'm adding before canary: - canary perf smoke (synthetic load) - kernel correctness smoke (top-k logits compare vs baseline) - KV pinning integrity checks (no misses for pinned prefixes) - priority routing smoke

sofia: Spectra ops signed off contingent on rollback path. I'll send timeline + invite them to the canary channel.

kenji: Also add a ticket reference in dedicated-config backlog and tag model on-call (alex) so any model-side changes don't invalidate fused kernel assumptions.

sofia: Added the ticket and tagged @alex. Thanks everyone — will update here when canary starts.
